env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Identical source positions in distinct files do not identify one tuple
# temporary. Packed and unpacked package initializers keep their own values.
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplenames

go 1.27

-- m/a.lgo --
package main

var a = pair(11)
var a0, a1 = a

-- m/b.lgo --
package main

var b = pair(22)
var b0, b1 = b

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Fields struct { A, B, C int }

var calls int

func pair(n int) (int, int) {
	calls++
	return n, n + 1
}

func expanded[T any]() int {
	total := 0
	const for i, _ := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		first := pair(i + 1)
		second := pair(i + 10)
		x, y := first
		var z, w = second
		total += x + y + z + w
	}
	return total
}

func main() {
	if a0 != 11 || a1 != 12 || b0 != 22 || b1 != 23 || calls != 2 {
		panic("package tuple initialization")
	}
	x := expanded[Fields]()
	y := expanded[Fields]()
	if x != 84 || y != 84 || calls != 14 {
		panic("expanded tuple initialization")
	}
	fmt.Println(a0, a1, b0, b1, x, y, calls)
}

-- m/expected.txt --
11 12 22 23 84 84 14
